digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service initialization and auth management
propositions: Long-running MCP and review-bot processes must bind static deployment config once at startup rather than re-reading per-operation to prevent inconsistent state
MCP inbound bearer tokens and OAuth material must remain request-scoped context and never enter startup bindings, operation snapshots, logs, or serialization
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM credentials) before accepting work and must not fall back to alternative principals if auth is missing or revoked
Each operation must receive a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot composed at call time while startup bindings remain stable across ambient config mutations
Static config changes are only observed after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned credential refresh behavior is preserved
Partial or rejected telemetry (Langfuse/OTLP) must disable observability without changing operation results; security-bearing auth remains fail-closed
